entries.title: TWSE 有價證券集中交易市場開（休）市日期表 / Holiday Schedule, 2010-2026
entries.notes: The exchange's annual table of non-trading days: 2010-2020 from archived captures of its trading_days / holidaySchedule pages (zh; the 2017 English table listing the 'Additional Trading Days on Saturday'), 2021-2026 from its live schedule endpoint (rwd/zh/holidaySchedule/holidaySchedule?date=<year>0101). Lists every holiday, substitute and bridge day, the settlement-only days before Lunar New Year, Labour Day, and the make-up Saturdays with whether the market trades (補行交易 through 2018; 補行上班，但不交易亦不交割 from 2019). The 2027 table was not yet published (the endpoint returned no rows). Retrieved via the Internet Archive captures recorded in sources/TW-TWSE/manifest.csv.

entries.title: TWSE 每日市場成交資訊 (daily market summary), every month January 2010 to October 2026, and the trading-day table compiled from it
entries.notes: The exchange's daily market summary (rwd/zh/afterTrading/FMTQIK?date=<year><month>01) lists every day the centralised market traded; the 202 monthly responses are preserved and twse-trading-days.csv compiles their 4,112 dates. The generated calendar's business days equal this record exactly, day by day, including the fifteen Saturday sessions and excluding every typhoon closure and settlement-only day. Retrieved via the Internet Archive captures recorded in sources/TW-TWSE/manifest.csv.

entries.title: TWSE 天然災害停止上班之處理 / Market closure for natural disasters (rule page, zh and en) and the related FAQ
entries.notes: "台北市市長宣布當日或當日上午台北市全體公教機關停止上班時，本公司集中交易市場全日休市": a full-day or morning suspension in Taipei closes the market for the whole day; an afternoon-only suspension keeps it open and cancels post-close trading; settlement due that day is postponed.

entries.title: TWSE corporate history and timeline (history.html; 60-year history, section 225)
entries.notes: Session 09:00-13:30 since 2 January 2001; "2019, Jan 1: The TWSE forgoes Saturday trading and settlement, even with the presence of work"; the 1993 typhoon-closure rule and the 1995 election-day closure rule; continuous matching from 23 March 2020.
